environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on AWS ECS Fargate (platform version 1.4.0) in us-east-1 VPC. Task role 'webhook-service-task-role' with S3:GetObject and DynamoDB:Query only. Task execution uses awsvpc networking with a dedicated ENI. VPC has a transparent egress proxy (Envoy-based sidecar, deployed as a secondary container in the same task definition) configured with an allowlist policy: outbound connections are permitted ONLY to destinations matching entries in the 'egress-allowlist' ConfigMap, which contains exactly two entries: the HSM proxy internal endpoint (hsm-proxy.internal:8443) and the corporate DNS resolver (10.0.0.2:53). The Envoy sidecar intercepts all TCP traffic via iptables REDIRECT rules (uid-based exclusion for proxy user only) and returns TCP RST for any connection attempt to a destination not in the allowlist. Additionally, the ECS task has IMDSv2 enforced at the instance level with hop-limit=1, and Fargate platform 1.4.0 blocks IMDS access from tasks entirely via the Fargate hypervisor network namespace isolation.
